title: 事实还是观点？
summary: 老师读出一句贴近生活的话，全班举手判断是事实还是观点。三关由浅入深，可以查证也不等于一定正确。
format: 老师投屏，全班举手判断

en.title: Fact or Opinion?
en.summary: Judge everyday statements as fact or opinion across three levels, and learn that checkable doesn't always mean correct.
en.format: Teacher projects; class votes by hand
